title: Sheaves on the small etale site restrict to an equivalence onto sheaves on affine etale schemes with the induced topology
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] with small etale site $S_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-site]; give $S_{\Et}$ the Grothendieck topology generated by its coverings (a sieve on $V$ is covering iff it contains the members of a jointly surjective family of etale morphisms $\{V_k\to V\}$). Let $\mathcal A_S$ be the category whose objects are pairs $(R,f)$ of a commutative ring $R$ and an etale morphism $f:\operatorname{Spec}R\to S$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum], with morphisms $(R,f)\to(R',f')$ the morphisms of schemes $g:\operatorname{Spec}R\to\operatorname{Spec}R'$ with $f'\circ g=f$, and let $P:\mathcal A_S\to S_{\Et}$ be the functor $(R,f)\mapsto(\operatorname{Spec}R\xrightarrow{f}S)$, $g\mapsto g$ (fully faithful). Give $\mathcal A_S$ the topology induced by $P$: a sieve $R$ on $c$ is covering iff the sieve on $P(c)$ generated by the morphisms $P(r)$, $r\in R$, is covering in $S_{\Et}$. Then for $\mathcal V$ the category of sets and for $\mathcal V$ the category of abelian groups, precomposition with $P$, $\mathcal G\mapsto\mathcal G\circ P$, carries sheaves on $S_{\Et}$ with values in $\mathcal V$ to sheaves on $\mathcal A_S$ and is an equivalence of categories $\operatorname{Sh}(S_{\Et},\mathcal V)\xrightarrow{\sim}\operatorname{Sh}(\mathcal A_S,\mathcal V)$.
